title: AGCP Metadata Response
description: Metadata response for AGCP HTTP interface capability discovery. Specification versioning is managed by repository release tags; this schema does not embed supported_spec_versions.

implementation_release.description: Implementation release identifier. This is not the AGCP specification version.

http_contract.description: Identifier or artifact reference for the implemented AGCP HTTP contract.

supported_capabilities.description: Implementation-supported AGCP capabilities, such as Proposal Qualification, Governance Decision Function, Execution Authorization, Commit Boundary, Continuation Integrity, Governance Evidence, Governance Self-Protection, or Autonomous Coordination.

registry_refs.description: Optional references to AGCP registries implemented by this deployment.
